title: TD Asset Management Inc. Announces Management Fee Reduction for TD Global Shareholder Yield Fund
body_markdown:
TORONTO, November 19, 2026 /CNW/ - TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM"), the manager of TD Mutual Funds, today announced management fee reductions for series of the TD Global Shareholder Yield Fund (the "Fund").


At TDAM, we are committed to delivering value and helping investors achieve their long-term goals. The reduction of management fees for the Fund reflects our ongoing focus on providing competitive, client-centric solutions. These changes ensure that more of our clients’ savings remain invested, helping them build wealth over time through the power of compounding.


An amendment to the offering documents of the TD Mutual Funds reflecting the following changes will be filed with the Canadian securities regulatory authorities on or about November 19, 2026.


**Lower management fees**


Effective November 19, 2026, TDAM will lower the management fees charged on all series of the Fund by 5 basis points (bps) as indicated in the table below:


**Series**


**Current Management Fee**


**New Management Fee**


Investor Series 1.90% 1.85%


Advisor Series 1.90% 1.85%


T8-Series 1.90% 1.85%


H8-Series 1.90% 1.85%


F-Series 0.90% 0.85%


FT5-Series 0.90% 0.85%


FT8-Series 0.90% 0.85%


D‑Series 0.90% 0.85%


Institutional Series 0.90% 0.85%


For more information regarding TD Mutual Funds, visit[TDAssetManagement.com](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=3570397-1&h=248428981&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.td.com%2Fca%2Fen%2Fasset-management%2F&a=TDAssetManagement.com.) .

**About TD Asset Management**


TD Asset Management (TDAM) is a global asset manager committed to helping clients achieve their investment objectives1. We are proud to serve institutional, intermediary and individual investors with solutions designed to address their evolving needs. Our specialized expertise and diverse perspectives enable us to navigate changing markets while pursuing long-term outcomes. TDAM offers a broad range of investment capabilities across public and private markets: fundamental equity strategies such as free cash flow-driven approaches, quantitative and passive equities; fixed income mandates across the credit quality spectrum; and alternative offerings such as commodities.


1 TD Asset Management represents TD Asset Management Inc. which operates in Canada and TD Asset Management (US), Inc. which operates in the U.S. Both entities are affiliates and wholly-owned subsidiaries of The Toronto-Dominion Bank.
